comments.author: @AprilMarshall-c3d
comments.text: Excellent point about being prepared for communications with possible manufacturers, investors, companies... It's imperative to explain exactly why the match is of the greatest possible benefits...leading by example, having the statistics ready, marketing research done, and fullest confidence in successful product launch, with specifics about targeted audiences, expansion plans, long-term sustainability, and definitely reliable expectations for the three to five year outlook...(Plan for dropping in a surprise celebrity endorsement!!!....Those have serious influence and major implications for exploding popularity....(OR...they might backfire and limit the focus for the core product loyalty base).... STILL, something to consider!!!...Many thanks kindest Sir!!
